lines.text: Many learners say: Can you explain me the rule?
Better: Can you explain the rule to me?
The second! Please explain this word to me.

data.wrong: Can you explain me the rule?
data.right: Can you explain the rule to me?

options: Please explain this word to me.

native.tip: Com “explain”, a pessoa vem depois de “to”: “explain it to me”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “Can you explain me the rule?” O certo é “Can you explain the rule to me?” Em português dizemos “me explica”, mas em inglês é “explain it to me”. Ouça a Ama e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “Please explain this word to me.” Agora escreva uma frase sua com esse ponto e treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: With “explain”, the person comes after “to”: “explain it to me”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “Can you explain me the rule?” The right way is “Can you explain the rule to me?” In Portuguese we say “me explica”, but in English it is “explain it to me”. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
